results.what: Printed Berlin University lecture catalogue, medical faculty section (page 4); no mathematical content

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a printed university course catalogue with no mathematics and no visible annotation by Riemann. Its only interest is archival: it is consistent with Riemann's Berlin student years (1847–49).
transcription_corrections: The line 'Die allgemeine Pathologie trägt Hr. Prof. Hecker' is physically obscured or cut in the image (a pasted or cropped strip); only fragments of the first line are legible. The reading is plausible but partly conjectural.
Similarly, 'und Sonnabends von 5-6 Uhr öffentlich' after 'Über die Verletzungen ... Jüngken Mittwochs' is partly obscured or cut in the image.
In 'Die allgemeine und specielle Pathologie der Geisteskrankheiten', the word 'und' is blotted or smudged in the image; the reading 'und' is correct from context.
Otherwise the machine transcription agrees with the image (pagination '4', all lecturers, days and hours).
